fields.description: Regional nonprofit (PLAN-NE) working to stop the overbuild of natural gas pipelines and other fossil fuel infrastructure in the Northeast, mainly by intervening in federal and state regulatory proceedings, and to promote clean energy.

projects.name: Opposing the Constitution Pipeline and Wright Interconnect revival
projects.description: Filing protests and comments at FERC against reinstating the certificates for Williams' Constitution Pipeline and Iroquois' Wright Interconnect, which could open the way to new gas pipeline expansions into New England.

projects.name: Enbridge Algonquin expansion (AGT-E / R.A.R.E.) watch
projects.description: Tracking Algonquin's 2026 FERC pre-filing for pipeline expansion work through Mendon, Bellingham, Franklin and Wrentham, MA and parts of Rhode Island.

fields.description: Volunteer group of Cape Cod residents in the 350.org network and 350 Mass that did climate education and advocacy, backing offshore wind and opposing new fossil fuel infrastructure on the Cape.
National nonprofit that campaigns for safe food, clean water and a livable climate, working to end fossil fuels and fracking, stop AI data centers and keep water affordable.

projects.name: Stipend Reform ballot question
projects.description: Campaign to change who controls extra 'leadership pay' for state legislators, including a statewide ballot question filed in 2025.

actions.name: Vote Yes on Question 1 (public records for the Legislature and governor)
actions.description: Act on Mass asks voters to support Question 1, which would make the Legislature and governor's office subject to the state public records law.

events.name: VietAID 2026 Gala Fundraiser: Beyond Our Bridge
